[h1] You can just play Classic Zombies, why are you buying Blood Reaver? [/h1] I wanted to like this game man, I love COD Zombies and over the past few months I've been playing through all the classic games in-depth to fully get that experience. I got through all of Black Ops 2, 3 and I'm ending it with 4 as everything after that point is considered the new era of COD Zombies and why we see this rise in players who want that classic experience again. [h2] Are you gonna get that classic experience playing Blood Reaver? Are you going to relive those lobbies you had learning where Power was and to use Pack-a-Punch? Is this a return to form? [/h2] [h3] Absolutely not. [/h3] You can still play all those old games on Steam. You even got mod support for all those games that means you can play all the Five Nights at Freddys, Anime Waifu, Brainrot, Remastered Maps all day long. Blood Reaver tried very hard to replicate the formula to the point it almost feels like it could be a custom map. You got all the perks you expect returning, costing exactly what you expect and doing exactly what you expected. They're just cards now besides bottles, and they've got really goofy names that nobody is gonna be using. - [b] 'Dancer' [/b] is their equivalent of [b] 'Speed Cola' [/b]. - [b] 'Huntress' [/b] is their equivalent of [b] 'Double Tap' [/b]. - [b] 'Vitalis' [/b] is their equivalent of [b] 'Juggernog' [/b]. - [b] 'Rebirth' [/b] is their equivalent of [b] 'Quick Revive' [/b]. - [b] 'Falconer' [/b] is their equivalent of [b] 'Stamin-Up' [/b]. [i] (There are other perks that aren't copies of existing perks, but the majority very much follow that example.) [/i] They even brought back 'Pack-A-Punch' but it's called 'The Blood Infuser' which is another thing nobody is gonna be calling that. When you take a mode like COD Zombies and try to copy it to such an extent like Blood Reaver, you're gonna get compared to it with everything. And you're not gonna win when getting compared to what fans regard as the best COD Zombies experience. If it tried to do more of it's own thing it wouldn't suffer from this consistent reminder of "I could be playing Black Ops 3 instead". You can be unique in this space, Killing Floor proved that and many other 4 player co-op horde shooters over the years have shown us great experiences that feel familiar yet unique to COD Zombies. Day 1 features that could of made this game more unique like it's 'Infusions' aren't here. The Loadout allowing you to bring in a special ability is neat on paper but has been seen in other COD Zombies games and acts the exact same as the special abilities you can get in the [b] Totally Not Mystery Box [/b]. However besides the abilities that just help kill Demons, you'll be subject to abilities such as giving you extra movement and reload speed temporarily, increased fire rate temporarily or slow the Demons temporarily. They are about as exciting as that gets unfortunately, nothing to really hammer in the atmosphere or the lore. There are Day 1 Early access bugs to be expected and a few missing QOL features that would of been nice to have, the weak audio designs to the weapons and lack of audio informing you of Demons behind you makes the game a bit frustrating but nothing that can't be fixed. This game launched with [b] 1 MAP [/b] and according to it's roadmap, Map 2 might not arrive until Q4 2026 or Q1 2027. Keep in mind we've just entered Q2 2026, so imagine waiting a whole year for a 2nd map. Keeping in mind a Roadmap that might not even be fulfilled, there is no guarantee so judge the game on if you could only play this 1 decent map for your whole playtime. [h2] TL:DR, [/h2] You can just play your old copy of Black Ops 3 and load up a Demon custom map. What makes this game better than those older games? I can't say anything. It has the potential to be a great competitor, the same way I could be a great competitor to Stephen King because I've written 1 half decent paragraph of a scary book. Blood Reaver has a long way to come and it's coming against Call of Duty. Ubisoft couldn't beat them, Electronic Arts couldn't beat them, so let's see how well this goes?

It's a proper round based survival games built on an occult aspect, Physics heavily resemble Black Ops 2 while adding some Black Ops 3 Physics alongside it. The Game just launched and at the time of this review it is only in V0.1 There is so much promise and room for this game to grow and become the next best thing! Hang in there and you will see this game become part of your weekend game-a-thon! For now just enjoy learning the perks abilities and weapons while infusing. See how far you can get! I would go ahead and buy it at the cheap rate they are basically handing out because there is no doubt in my mind this game will succeed and they will raise the price! I hope you enjoy the game as much as I do! Also this game is not stuttery or laggy in any way shape or form it is so well optimized! If you are lagging its most definitely you not knowing how to configure your video setting or not meeting the needed hardware requirements! Don't blame hardworking devs' for your own issues...

I’m writing this as someone who is pretty good at CoDZ. I can usually hit high rounds depending on the map, examples include: 60 on Shadows of Evil, 80 on Nacht der Untoten and around 50 on Kino der Toten. (Nacht my GOAT) With that in mind, I think Blood Reaver is pretty promising, but it definitely needs more time to grow. Right now, the player just feels really weak. Some wall buys struggle to kill, even with headshots. It also seems like the game is balanced more for a full party rather than solo. I can only make it to around round 15 before it starts feeling rough. Performance-wise, I actually haven’t had any issues, which surprised me since my PC is on the lower end compared to most of my friends. Especially when I read other reviews. My biggest problem is the sound and visuals though. The guns just don’t feel good to use the firing sounds are very unfitting and not very satisfying. The lighting also feels really dull, and overall the game just looks kinda flat, honestly worse than some Roblox games. That said, I do think people who like CoDZ but don’t want to support ActiBlizz should keep an eye on this. It’s got potential, it just needs some work. But for as the game stands right now, not recommended.

My two cons is 1: The game desperately needs music and 2: The grenade currently feels yucky to use. Perfect $15 game to play with the fellas.

playing a few rounds this game definitely has good bones. I think as an early access title it has a great foundation to build off of, with the idea being to expand core systems and build on the wave-shooter genre, this current version does not do that, BUT its a good start. Movement is fun, the guns are enjoyable, but my main issues stem from things that I'm sure will get polished out and balanced once the game gets further into development including: some things are too expensive (i think because the map itself is a bit small so balance-wise it makes sense) hit boxes are a bit wacky at times leading to some "how did i down there" moments some guns feel a bit odd/weightless Overall, fun time and as someone who has hundreds of hours in Treyarch zombies, this has a good, solid foundation and i hope they're able to build it up even further!

Fun game that is a spiritual successor to COD Zombies. It has a lot of promise but much of the game feels unbalanced. The demons are way too fast in later rounds, especially when they put the faster run perk as a random drop. Guns are still too weak after the balance update and the demons pathing gets confused a lot. I will say however the map itself is stellar with a fun and easy to memorize layout. The art and weapon designs are also incredible I just hope the visuals are eventually updated to really let it shine. I look forward to its future and what they already have planned with the roadmap.

This game is absolutely perfect for me. I’ve been wanting to play a new game that has the same mechanics of WAW zombies for so long, it’s super exciting to have found this! Things I love: The design of the guns with the metal and wood Incorperated together and the filigree carved in to some of the metal is so perfect! My favorites are the trench gun and Galil, your designs for those two are so creative and also you know exactly what gun you are seeing. The pack a punch camo is so refreshing, I have been so burnt out on camos that move in impossible ways. The way you Incorperated that red stuff from around the map into the gun to give it more power is absolutely perfect! The gameplay is smoooth, it feels very consistent and I have had no glitches or anything that feels unfinished. Even knifing through windows is effortless instead of how it is in WAW I love that you can do the slide jumps from BO3, and I also love that you can’t do them an unlimited number of times. The map layout is very good, and the design of the location is absolutely sick. I love the vibe of it! The difficulty is crazy hard, I got the raygun packed and I still died on round 16. I’m trying to get my friends to buy it so we can make it farther than that. I love how it actually feels like an accomplishment to survive instead of how new COD zombies feels like survival is almost guaranteed and you only survive so that you can get more xp for the battle pass. The exploding demons were a surprise and are super cool because of how intimidating they are! The tank demons feel like they aren’t just a waste of ammo since you get points for shooting them. Speaking of ammo, you have just the right amount of it for each gun I have used. It never feels too scarce or too plentiful. I’m always thinking about how much I have left in a good way. I love that you have to put your gun in pack a punch and wait for it to come back out. They stopped doing that in COD and it ruined the whole feel of pack a punch. The location you put it in is crazy cool too because you can very easily die up there if you’re not careful with your timing! I love how simple it is! I think you guys are working on an Easter egg, my biggest request for that is, please do not have anyone talking at you through a walkie talkie the whole time, just have people naturally find clues and steps like the old ones! Also, objective markers are so silly, please leave the hud as simple as it already is, it’s perfect that way. Things I would change: I’d love it if jug could change from 4,000 to 2,500, it is so hard to get it. When I stand up from being downed with the galil, I have to extend the stock again and sometimes get killed because there are zombies right next to me and I can’t shoot. That’s all that I would change! I’d love to see a new map with different enemies, not saying I don’t like these ones, but it would be super cool to have map specific enemies! I hope you guys are adding in leveling up and unlocking skins on your guns! I’d love to get a gold skin on the galil that still has the wood on it and filigree engraved in it. Amazing work, this game is so fun!

This is very much a yes but with caveats. It is essentially the same gameplay format as Call of Duty Zombies. If I was to give you a specific era it feels somewhere around the late Black Ops 2 to Black Ops 3 era of the game mode when you get a bit more of the wacky boss enemies and the art style goes from the more relatively grounded to the more insane. On the art, it's a fairly stylistic with a lot of funny designs of weapons (I love the 3 barrelled revolver) that feel like it sits in the realm of WW1 era weaponry if combined with the demons and silliness, I find it fun because it's not too serious. The caveat is, it is ultimately an early access game with a couple bugs (only one I experienced was the game freezing and the audio getting incredibly loud) but also it's fairly shallow in the amount of content. They only have one map, a pretty solid map but only a singular map, and they have a levelling system but as it stands at the moment, it's really easy to get to level 20 and there isn't more after that level. Ultimately these are issues because it is early in the game's lifespan, an Early Access game that's been out for a few months. excited to see them improve upon the progression systems and hopefully add more maps.

As a fan of the OG Black Ops 1 & 2 zombies who found BO3's iteration (and beyond) incredibly mid, I highly recommend Blood Reaver. It perfectly scratches that dormant craving without all the modern slop that currently weighs down the CoD franchise. The only major issue that I encountered during gameplay is a movement bug. I believe it was triggered by my abuse of the slide-jump mechanic. It locked my jump direction to my most recent slide, causing me to launch you backward directly into my train of demons. Regardless, I absolutely love what the team is cooking, and hope to see this bug fixed in a future update. TLDR: If you're an OG zombies fan, I would invest in Blood Reaver. While it is still in early access and there isn't a lot of content, I believe that the devs have the sauce.

If you are a fan of OG Call of Duty zombies, this game is perfect for you. Combat and gun play is fun, there is a few hiccups, the lack of more than one map kinda sucks and sometimes performance can be choppy. But what is there is definitely worth it.

I purchased this game because of the art style and the videos supporting the game and played the demo. Since playing the game a little bit more, I am miffed at the savage difficulty of the demons in it, along with the totally crap weapons when you progress a bit further into the game. I can easily keep up in COD Zombies but here, ppffttt, this game is optimised so poorly that all my bang on headshots somehow miss. If you are going to the trouble of making a game such as this, and if it is meant to be difficult, then as a shooter you better make sure that shooting and movement is absolutely spot on. In this case, sadly it is not. It ruins the game because as soon as you get to a more challenging level, demons get you in a split second, thats it!! The game map, is really good, although 1 map only is pretty poor, that should be pointed out at sale. I thought there would be more maps, but all that is there is what was in the demo. The concept of the game, with levelling and powers is also a great idea, but sadly guns, ammo and powers all feel useless against the enemy, particularly close up, in a map where there are virtually no open spaces or safety areas, go figure? Why in a FPS ??? There is obviously quite a few balancing issues to sort out. The strength of the demons in round 5 should not feel like they are round 30, even though you might have a weker gun, particularly on solo. maybe the number of demons also need to be addressed, once again, especially on solo. If you want good sales then you need to improve these aspects of the game fast. Please give us big improvements in this game as it could be really good if you mange to make the required changes.
